mapper.update: update ontology_mcp_token set last_used = now() where token_id = #{tokenId}
mapper.select: select space_id, space_name, description, create_by, create_time from wiki_space where status = #{status} order by create_time desc
select task_id, task_name, status, summary, create_by, create_time, update_time from analysis_task order by update_time desc limit #{limit}
select task_id, status from analysis_task where task_id = #{taskId}
select config_json from ontology_proposal where task_id = #{taskId} order by proposal_id desc limit 1
select token_id, token_name, created_by, create_time, last_used, status from ontology_mcp_token where created_by = #{username} order by token_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into ontology_mcp_token (token_name, token_hash, created_by, create_time, status) values (#{tokenName}, #{tokenHash}, #{username}, now(), 1)
mapper.delete: delete from ontology_mcp_token where token_id = #{tokenId} and created_by = #{username}
